meta.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
meta.subtitle: How a Transformer computes attention over a sequence, step by step

views.label: The core computation
views.note: The three steps that turn Q/K/V into attention weights.

views.label: Full forward pass
views.note: Every step from input projection to final output.

steps.label: Project Q, K, V
steps.description: The input embeddings are projected into query, key, and value matrices using three learned weight matrices.

code.content:
Q = x @ W_q
K = x @ W_k
V = x @ W_v

steps.label: Compute attention scores
steps.description: Each query is compared against every key via dot product, then scaled to keep gradients stable.

steps.label: Softmax normalization
steps.description: Scores are normalized into a probability distribution over the sequence, so each query attends to keys in proportion to relevance.

steps.label: Weighted sum of values
steps.description: The normalized weights are used to compute a weighted average of the value vectors.

steps.label: Attention output
steps.description: Each position now holds a context vector blending information from every position it attended to, ready for the next layer.
